name: Roma
long_description:
Roma is the to-do list that does itself. Two of our three founders have been through YC before: Jan built Loom (W12, acquired by Dropbox) and Tobi built Senic (S13, acquired by Gira).

Most of the work we do starts and ends with a task. So we're rebuilding something everyone already uses: the to-do list that becomes your everyday assistant, the one place that already knows everything you need done.
one_liner: Roma is the to-do list that does itself

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder / CEO at Roma (YC F26). Previously founder at Loom (YC W12 - acquired by Dropbox).

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Currently Co-Founder of Roma (F26). Previously Co-Founder of Senic (YC S13), acquired by GIRA. Programmer and designer. 3x Red Dot Award winner. Passionate long-distance runner. Love to sketch. https://www.tobiaseichenwald.com/

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Building something new at YC (F26). Writer, director, and entrepreneur with nearly two decades of experience in brand marketing and creative. Previously agency creative at Goodby Silverstein & Partners and 72andSunny, in-house director at Dropbox, and co-founder of The Goondocks, an award-winning creative studio.
